title: Hearty Japanese Parma Ham Dorayaki
description: A fermented, gooey, lazy‑sunday dish that pairs savory Parma ham with a sweet miso glaze, rimmed with binchotan charcoal for a subtle smoky touch, all wrapped in macrobiotic‑friendly buckwheat pancakes.
instructions: Warm the buckwheat dorayaki pancakes in a skillet over medium heat until lightly crisp.
Spread a thin layer of miso paste over the center of each pancake.
Layer two slices of Parma ham on top of the miso.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and a pinch of binchotan charcoal powder over the ham.
Drizzle maple syrup and dust ground cinnamon over the filling.
Fold the pancake halves together to enclose the ham.
Heat a non‑stick pan over low heat and gently press the assembled dorayaki to meld flavors.
Cook each side for 2 minutes until golden and fragrant.
Remove from heat and let rest for one minute to settle.
Slice the dorayaki into bite‑size squares and serve warm.
